entities.summary: Sir Wayne Thomas Shelford is a New Zealand former rugby union player and coach who represented and captained New Zealand in the late 1980s. Nicknamed "Buck", he played as a number eight for Auckland, North Harbour, Northampton and Rugby Roma.
